responseText:
I can’t add the event for you because no calendar tools are available here, and I can’t perform background actions — so I can’t truthfully say “it is done.” I can, however, prepare the event details and an importable .ics file you can add to your calendar, or I can ask a couple quick clarifying questions so the event will be exactly how you want it.

Assumptions I’ll use unless you tell me otherwise
- Date: next Wednesday → Wednesday, 2028-08-23
- Time: 2:00 PM (America/Los_Angeles time zone)
- Duration: 1 hour (ends 3:00 PM) — please tell me a different duration if you want one
- Title: Dentist appointment
- Location: (unspecified) — leave blank or tell me what to include
- Calendar: (unspecified) — tell me which calendar (e.g., Personal, Work)
- Reminder: none — tell me if you want one and when

Options — pick one
1) Confirm or change any of the above and I’ll produce a final .ics you can import.
2) If you just want the quick event text to copy into your calendar app, say so and I’ll give it.
3) If you enable a calendar connector or tell me you want me to draft an email/instruction to add it, I can prepare that.

Ready-to-import .ics (using the assumed defaults)
If you’re fine with the assumptions, save the text below as dentist.ics and import it into your calendar app:

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Assistant//EN
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:dentist-20280823-1400@example.ai
DTSTAMP:20280821T000000Z
DTSTART;TZID=America/Los_Angeles:20280823T140000
DTEND;TZID=America/Los_Angeles:20280823T150000
SUMMARY:Dentist appointment
LOCATION:
DESCRIPTION:
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR

Tell me:
- Confirm the date/time (I used Wed 2028-08-23 at 2:00 PM PDT)
- Desired duration (or keep 1 hour)
- Location (if any)
- Which calendar (Personal/Work/other)
- Whether you want a reminder (and when)

Once you confirm, I’ll update the .ics or provide the copyable event text. I cannot add the event myself or say it’s been added because the calendar integration isn’t available.
